title: Auto mode is now the default in Claude Code
summary: Anthropic has made Auto mode the default setting in Claude Code, their CLI tool for AI-assisted coding. Auto mode allows Claude to autonomously execute commands and make changes without requiring constant user approval, significantly improving workflow efficiency. This change reflects a shift toward more autonomous AI coding assistants that can handle multi-step tasks with minimal intervention.
problem_solved: Reduces friction in AI-assisted coding by eliminating the need for constant user approval on every action, enabling more seamless autonomous workflows.
why_valuable: Developers can now leverage AI coding assistants more efficiently for complex, multi-step tasks while maintaining oversight through review modes for sensitive operations.
